Nora: Kicking off CareBridge onboarding sprint 0. Goals: connect feed, validate mapping, pilot in 6 weeks. Need owners, success criteria, and any immediate blockers.
Diego: I'm the customer PM (Diego Alvarez). Internal owners: Priya (Clinical), Ken (IT), Mei (Data). Data residency: EU only for pilot.
Nora: Thanks. Proposed milestones: Week 1: staging + sample data; Week 2: mapping; Week 3-4: validation + smoke; Week 5-6: pilot. Go/no-go at end of Week 2 if mapping passes.
Asha: SE note  request 100-row NDJSON masked sample. If avg note >8KB we'll recommend chunking and async ingest.
Cal: Infra/security: need SAML metadata + SOC2 link. Security intake ETA 5bd after docs. If SSO delays, we can do scoped invites for pilot.
Sam: I'll own clinician enablement. Plan: 45-min demo + two 30-min office hours. Success metrics: median task time <150s, ingest error rate <0.7%, pilot adoption >=65% by week 4. Renewal risk triggers: adoption <40% or >2 P1s/week.
Diego: We'll collect feedback via short in-app surveys and weekly 15-min interviews. I'll send pilot clinician roster by Thu.
Nora: Action items: 1) Diego upload sample + roster (due 2026-09-10). 2) Asha publish integration doc + chunking guidance (due 2026-09-12). 3) Cal/security start intake (ETA 5bd). 4) Sam prep enablement materials (draft due 2026-09-14).
